mapper.sql: g.group_id, g.leader_id, g.group_name, g.max_members, g.description, g.is_private, g.is_deleted, g.group_image, g.created_at, g.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM group_member m WHERE m.group_id = g.group_id AND m.join_status = 'APPROVED') AS member_count, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(t.tag_name ORDER BY t.tag_id SEPARATOR ',') FROM group_tag gt JOIN tag t ON t.tag_id = gt.tag_id WHERE gt.group_id = g.group_id) AS tags
mapper.select: SELECT FROM crew_group g WHERE g.group_id = #{groupId} AND g.is_deleted = 'N'
SELECT FROM crew_group g JOIN group_member gm ON gm.group_id = g.group_id WHERE gm.user_id = #{userId} AND gm.join_status = 'APPROVED' AND g.is_deleted = 'N' ORDER BY g.created_at DESC
SELECT FROM crew_group g JOIN group_member gm ON gm.group_id = g.group_id WHERE gm.user_id = #{userId} AND gm.join_status = 'PENDING' AND g.is_deleted = 'N' ORDER BY g.created_at DESC
SELECT FROM crew_group g WHERE g.is_deleted = 'N' AND g.is_private = 'N' AND g.group_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY g.created_at DESC

SELECT gm.group_member_id, gm.user_id, u.name, u.birthday, u.gender, gm.applied_at, gm.leave_reason, gm.left_at FROM group_member gm JOIN `user` u ON u.user_id = gm.user_id WHERE gm.group_id = #{groupId} AND gm.join_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY gm.applied_at

SELECT gm.user_id, u.name, u.user_image, gm.member_role, gm.processed_at AS joined_at FROM group_member gm JOIN `user` u ON u.user_id = gm.user_id WHERE gm.group_id = #{groupId} AND gm.join_status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY gm.member_role, gm.processed_at

SELECT gw.group_warning_id, gw.group_id, gw.admin_id, gw.warning_reason, gw.created_at, u.name AS admin_name FROM group_warning gw JOIN `user` u ON u.user_id = gw.admin_id WHERE gw.group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY gw.created_at DESC
